name: Support Caela/Soren C
_source: speak;Caela;You handle a lance well for someone who spent time with rebels.
speak;Soren;Rebel camps aren't short on combat practice.
speak;Caela;Was it what you expected? Joining them?
speak;Soren;No. I thought they wanted to defend Valdres. Turns out they wanted to sell it.
speak;Caela;Your magic is interesting, by the way. Efficient form.
